task: Operator returns use the saved REST orderLine mapping
authorization: User asked to continue fixing SOM06642 and identified the existing saved REST orderLine IDs used by IF.

setup.dependencies: No new dependencies; use existing Docker Node, PostgreSQL, node:test, fast-check, c8, TypeScript and ESLint.
setup.git: Preserve the dirty workspace; no commits or wholesale deployment.
setup.artifacts: Persist tests, source snapshots, one gauntlet entry point, scoped deployment tooling and JSON evidence.

scenarios: A complete stored mapping resolves by Sales Order ID, stable line key and item ID, preserving the exact saved positive REST ID rather than the stable key or row position.
A workflow-locked Sales Order with a complete mapping submits one correctly linked RA without a REST source-order GET.
Live fulfilled quantities, UOM, rates, item return policies, receiving-yard rules and return reservations retain their existing validation.
Missing stored mappings retain the existing authoritative REST lookup for historical orders; no mapping is guessed or written to the database.
Wrong order/item identities, duplicate source keys, duplicate REST IDs and invalid populated REST IDs fail before local return admission or NetSuite creation.
Unrelated stored rows and inactive rows cannot supply another live line's mapping; repeated SKUs are mapped by stable key.
Concurrent identical confirmations and uncertain responses retain the existing one-RA/recovery protection.
SOM06642 is verified read-only against deployed source at yard 150; actual RA creation and physical-return confirmation remain with the Operator.

failureModel.wrongSourceOrLine: Pure unit/property tests, hostile identities, real database integration and mutation of order/item/duplicate guards.
failureModel.cachedBusinessData: Integration verifies live quantity, UOM and rate despite stale stored order status/quantity.
failureModel.lockStillTriggers: Transport rejects every source SO GET while a complete stored mapping must succeed.
failureModel.doubleRA: Existing return concurrency/uncertain-response regressions plus a mapped-source concurrency case.
failureModel.unrelatedDeployment: Overlay only the return mapping module and its caller on exact current images, compare full trees, preserve runtime configuration and keep rollback images.
failureModel.regressions: Fresh baseline versus final full suite, scoped types/lint/coverage, independently exercised property mutations and shuffled focused tests.

revisions.reason: The initial concurrency test incorrectly required every simultaneous confirmation reply to be succeeded; existing idempotent replays may return pending while the first request posts.
revisions.criterion: Eight concurrent identical confirmations create exactly one RA, share the same batch, expose only pending or verified success, and a final replay plus saved record show the same succeeded RA. No unrelated response-contract change.

invariants: No production NetSuite transaction is created for testing.
No workflow, feature gate, credential, mapping row, return quantity or order status is changed by the fix.
No public API, schema or UI change. Existing historical REST mapping remains available.
